svg.title: 3. Identity, Secrets, Observability, Evidence & Lifecycle
svg.text: Four platform concerns and what each has actually proven.
Validated inside the closed runtime windows. No runtime is live now.
non-sensitive runtime configuration only; explicitly not
MFA at sign-in; ReadOnly or Administrator permission set;
no long-lived human access keys, bootstrap included
one per environment and the only entry point for workload
enriches with environment, service and artifact digest
environment health, workload golden signals, deployed-version
versioned; object versions are its only recovery path
Pod Identity was selected because its role trust names one
generic EKS service principal, so IAM roles stay durable and
an ephemeral cluster only recreates lightweight associations.
Measured clusterlessly, then validated on EKS inside closed
runtime windows. No runtime is live now. Clusterless
measurement alone is not EKS runtime proof.
The trace backend is deliberately unselected: ADR-0010 defers
the Jaeger-versus-Tempo choice to implementation evidence, and
current state keeps Tempo as a provisional candidate only.
One validated investigation exercise, a deliberately induced
fault traced from alert to root cause to verified recovery, is
required before this model counts as implemented. It has
AWS-native audit and control-plane records stay in their AWS
services. Neither side ingests the other, and no signal is
Evidence is exported before teardown, and only sanitized
evidence is ever published. The repository is not yet
published, so the publication step is a target rather than
Exercised end to end across every closed runtime window.
Ephemeral runtime resources are removed after every
approved window; persistent foundation resources are
intentionally retained, so the platform never claims to
VALIDATED proven by captured evidence, at the badge's stated scope
PARTIAL capability exists for part of the fleet only
NOT LIVE implemented and validated in closed windows; no runtime now
PLANNED accepted or designed, not yet exercised
RETAINED survives environment teardown by design
